definition.definition: raw_i = m3_i*(1 + 0.5*clip(snap_trend_i, -0.3, 0.3)) + 0.5*max(0, persist_i); persist_i = mean(last two shares) - mean(earlier up to six shares) when BOTH of the last two shares exceed that earlier mean by >= 0.03, else 0; m3_i = prior-3 team mean share; snap_trend_i = last-game offense snap pct - mean of the previous up to two (0 when snaps are missing); teammate vacancy is handled by normalizing raw scores over the target-week ACTIVE eligible roster only; players without history receive 0.15 * Phase1D position cold-start share; shares normalize to 1.

snap_note: uses offense snap trend where the exact id join exists (missing -> 0); a conservative (stronger) comparator than the blocked family B
